faq: How much does the horse ride on Koh Samui's south coast cost? | Group rides cost 1,700 THB at 07:00, 1,800 THB at 08:30, 1,900 THB at 16:00 and 2,500 THB for the 17:30 sunset ride. A group lesson is 2,200 THB and private lessons run 2,900–3,500 THB depending on the slot.

Can children join the beach and jungle horse ride? | Yes, from about age 5–6. Each child rides their own horse with a guide alongside and pays the same price as an adult. Tell us the child's age, height and weight so the stables can choose a quiet horse.

Is hotel pickup included with the horse riding? | No. The stables are on the south coast. A private van costs 1,100 THB one way or 2,500 THB return for up to 4 people, plus 200 THB per extra passenger. Many guests staying in Lamai or the south ride over by taxi or scooter.
What does the horse riding price include? | Your own horse for the hour, a riding guide and accident insurance. Drinks, transfers and tips are extra.

How long is the ride, and which slot is best? | Each ride is about 1 hour. The 07:00 and 17:30 slots are coolest; the 17:30 ride finishes around sunset, which is why it costs more. Midday rides are not offered because of the heat.

Do the horse rides go ahead in the rain? | Light rain usually doesn't stop a ride, but storms and lightning do. October to December is the wettest period and trails can be muddy. If the stables cancel for weather, you choose a new date or a full refund.

What is the cancellation policy for the horse ride? | 4 or more days before departure you get a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50% back; within 24 hours or for a no-show there is no refund.

What should I wear for horse riding on Koh Samui, and are there limits? | Long trousers and closed shoes. The stables ask for each rider's weight, height and experience level (0–10) at booking; complete beginners are fine. Riders who are pregnant or have back problems should choose another activity.

Can young children come to the Chaweng Noi elephant sanctuary? | Yes. The child price covers ages 4–11 (the venue also quotes 6–11 for some bookings, so tell us your children's ages). Children stay with an adult and the guide at all times around the elephants.

Is hotel pickup included for the elephant sanctuary in Chaweng Noi? | Yes, a return minibus transfer is included from hotels in the main beach areas. Villas on steep mountain roads may be asked to meet the minibus at the nearest main road; we confirm this on WhatsApp.

Do you ride or bathe the elephants at this sanctuary? | No. There is no riding and no bathing or mud-spa session. You watch the elephants from an observation platform, help with feeding and walk behind them through the forest.

Does the elephant sanctuary visit run when it rains? | Yes. Light rain doesn't stop the programme and the restaurant is covered. In heavy rain the jungle walk may be shortened for safety; the visit is cancelled only in severe weather, and then you choose a new date or a full refund.

What should I wear to the elephant sanctuary? | Closed shoes or sturdy sandals, light clothes that can get dusty, a hat and insect repellent. The walk is on uneven paths but not steep. Leave perfume off; it can bother the elephants.

Can children do the Lamai zipline? | The venue sets no fixed minimum age, only a 100 kg maximum weight, and children pay the same price as adults. Small children ride with a staff member where the guides judge it safe; message us with ages before booking.

Is transport to Lamai Viewpoint included in the zipline price? | No. A private return van costs 2,500 THB for 1–10 people. From central Lamai it is a short taxi ride, and the entrance road is steep, so take care if you ride a scooter.

What do the Lamai zipline packages include? | Every package includes the viewpoint entrance, harness, helmet and a guide. Higher packages add more zip rides, the cable car up instead of walking, the Sky Adventure course and a drone video of your ride.
How long does the zipline at Lamai Viewpoint take? | About 2 hours from 09:00 check-in to finishing at the viewpoint café around 11:00. Walk-up packages take a little longer than cable car packages.
Does the Lamai zipline run in rain or wind? | It runs daily when the weather allows. Rides stop in lightning and strong wind; in that case you can wait, move to another day or take a full refund.

What happens if I cancel my Lamai zipline booking? | 4 or more days before departure you get a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50% back; within 24 hours or for a no-show there is no refund.

faq: How much is the private snorkelling speedboat from Koh Samui? | For up to 4 guests: 22,000 THB to Koh Phangan, 26,000 THB to Pig Island and Koh Rap, 29,000 THB to Ang Thong and 32,000 THB to Koh Tao. Each extra guest costs 1,000 THB, up to 10 on board.

Can kids come on the private snorkel speedboat? | Yes. Children count as guests in the boat price, and life jackets are provided. Snorkelling is from the boat or a beach depending on the stop, so non-swimmers can stay on the boat or in the shallows.

Which hotels get free transfer for the private snorkelling charter? | Transfer is included from Maenam, Bophut, Bang Rak, Choeng Mon, Chaweng and Chaweng Noi. Lamai and the south and west coasts are on request; message us first.

What is included on the private snorkelling boat? | The boat and crew, a snorkel guide, masks, snorkels and life jackets, snacks, water and soft drinks, and the hotel transfer. Lunch, kayaking and island fees are paid separately.
How long is the private snorkelling day? | It is a full day. Your start time is agreed when you book; Koh Tao is the longest run at about 1.5 hours each way, and Koh Phangan the shortest.

What happens to the private snorkel charter if the sea is rough? | The captain decides on the day. Strong north-east winds from October to December can close the Koh Tao and Ang Thong routes; in that case we offer a sheltered route, a new date or a full refund.

Can I cancel the private snorkelling speedboat? | 4 or more days before departure you get a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50% back; within 24 hours or for a no-show there is no refund.

Can I snorkel at Ang Thong on the private speedboat in November? | No. Ang Thong National Marine Park is closed from 1 November to 15 December, so that route runs from 16 December. Koh Phangan, Pig Island and Koh Rap and Koh Tao run all year when the sea allows.

How old do you have to be for the private dive charter? | Divers must be at least 10, which is the PADI minimum. Children aged 10–11 dive to shallower limits with an instructor; non-divers of any age can ride along and snorkel at most sites.
Is hotel pickup included with the private dive boat? | Yes, from Maenam, Bophut, Bang Rak, Choeng Mon, Chaweng and Chaweng Noi. Lamai and the south and west coasts are on request.
What is included in the private scuba charter? | The boat and crew, an instructor or guide, 2 dives, all dive equipment, lunch, fruit, snacks and drinks, accident insurance and the hotel transfer.
How long is a private dive day from Koh Samui? | A full day with 2 dives. Koh Ma is the shortest trip; Koh Tao takes about 1.5 hours each way, so expect to be back late afternoon.

Is Sail Rock diveable from Samui in the rainy season? | Sail Rock is exposed, and strong north-east winds from October to December can make it unsafe. The captain may switch to Koh Ma or another sheltered site; if no site is safe, you choose a new date or a full refund.

How do I cancel the private scuba charter? | 4 or more days before departure you get a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50% back; within 24 hours or for a no-show there is no refund.

Can I dive on the private charter if I'm not certified? | Yes. Non-certified guests do an instructor-led introductory dive to a maximum of 12 m after a briefing. You must complete the PADI medical form; some conditions, such as asthma or recent surgery, need a doctor's sign-off first.

Can kids ride on the jungle quad tour? | Children aged 5 and over can ride as passengers, and under-12s must sit behind an adult. From 12 they can drive their own quad after passing a short riding test at the base.

Is hotel pickup included for the quad ride? | Yes, a return hotel transfer is included at no extra cost, with pickups at 10:00 and 14:00. Villas on steep or narrow roads may be asked to meet the van at the nearest main road.

What's included in the quad bike jungle ride? | The quad and helmet, a safety briefing and practice, a trail guide and the hotel transfer. On the 2-hour ride you also get a drink at the jungle bar. Lunch, photos and tips are extra.

Should I choose the 1-hour or 2-hour quad ride? | The 1-hour ride covers jungle trails and stream crossings. The 2-hour ride adds viewpoints and a waterfall stop with time to swim when there is enough water, usually from about October to January.

Do the quad rides go ahead in the rainy season? | Yes. Rain makes the trails muddier and more fun but slower; guides shorten routes if streams are too high. In storms the ride is cancelled and you choose a new date or a full refund.

Who should not book the quad bike ride, and what should I wear? | It is not suitable during pregnancy or for people with back, neck or heart problems. Wear closed shoes and clothes that can get muddy, and bring spare clothes for the ride home.

From what age can children join the elephant museum and sanctuary programmes? | Children aged 5–11 pay the child price and 12+ pay the adult price. No minimum age is published; under-5s are usually welcome but must be carried or stay with an adult on the jungle walk, so message us first.

Does the elephant museum tour include hotel transfer? | Yes. All four programmes include a return air-conditioned minibus transfer from hotels and villas across the island, with pickups at 07:45, 08:00 or 12:45 depending on the programme.

Will I bathe or ride the elephants on this sanctuary tour? | No. There is no riding, no performing and no bathing with guests. You prepare and hand out food, walk alongside the herd and watch them from a respectful distance.

Which elephant sanctuary programme should I choose? | Choose the half day if you want the most time with the elephants, including feeding. Choose the museum and jungle walk to learn the history of Samui's working elephants on a shorter, cheaper visit. The wellness day is a waterfall hike with no elephants.

Is the elephant sanctuary visit affected by rain? | Programmes run in light rain, and the museum is indoors. In heavy rain the jungle walk is shortened. If the visit is cancelled for safety, you choose a new date or a full refund.

Can I get a refund if I cancel the elephant museum tour? | 4 or more days before departure you get a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50% back; within 24 hours or for a no-show there is no refund.

Does the jeep safari pick up from my hotel? | Yes. The jeep collects you from your hotel around 09:00 and drops you back around 16:00. Villas up narrow roads may be asked to wait at the nearest main road.
Is the lunch on the jeep safari fully vegan? | Yes. The buffet is vegan, so it also suits vegetarians and guests avoiding dairy. Tell us about nut, gluten or other allergies when you book.
How long does the Samui jeep safari last? | About 7 hours, from 09:00 pickup to around 16:00 drop-off. About half the day is driving between stops in the open jeep.

Does the jeep safari run in the rain? | Yes. The jeeps have a roof but open sides, so you may get wet in heavy showers from October to December. The guide may change the order of stops. If the tour is cancelled for safety, you choose a new date or a full refund.

Is there a child ticket for Muay Thai on Koh Samui? | Only at Phetchbuncha, where children under 140 cm pay 750 THB standard or 1,000 THB ringside. Samui International charges the adult price for everyone. Fights finish around midnight, so it is a late night for children.
Do the Muay Thai tickets include hotel transfer? | No. Both stadiums are in Chaweng, a short taxi ride from most east-coast hotels. We can arrange a private return transfer on request.

Which nights are the Muay Thai fights at each Chaweng stadium? | Phetchbuncha fights on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday; Samui International on Tuesday, Friday and Sunday. There are no fights on Thursday, and cards can change on Buddhist holidays.
How long is a Muay Thai fight night in Chaweng? | About 3 hours. The first bout starts around 21:00 and the last ends around midnight. Main-event fights usually come later in the evening.

Is Muay Thai cancelled if it rains? | No. Both stadiums are covered, so fights go ahead in the rain. Only an official cancellation of the card stops the night; if that happens, you choose another night or a full refund.
